Revised FDA Inspection Policy, Procedure and Work Instructions
The attached are the latest and greatest versions of the Managing FDA Inspection SOP's. They have been through a
number of reviews and are now consistent with each other and the training provided by Art Levine, et.al.
The largest change is that the Work Instructions detailing responsibilities for members of the inspection teams have
been folded into the procedure and therefor have been eliminated. Use these to prepare your plans and to assist in
training. As always, input is accepted and any questions are invited.
